statement: In the 2026 literature 'environment scaling' denotes the supply of interactive, verifiable environments for post-training rather than model- or data-side scaling; Environment Evolution states it as "Scaling interactive and verifiable environments is critical for training terminal agents".
falsification: A source that defines environment scaling as scaling the model, the parameters or the training data would falsify this; none of the thirteen notes uses it that way.

statement: The axis is stated as a post-training dependency, not an evaluation convenience: Terminal-Universe writes that "environments are what agent post-training actually requires: each can be re-queried into many verifiable tasks and provides execution feedback, whereas a trajectory is a single frozen demonstration".
falsification: A source that treats environments as evaluation-only, with no post-training role, would falsify this.

statement: The published environment-count/capability relation is positive but saturating: Agent-World reports that increasing training environments from 0 to 1978 moved the average score from 18.4% to 38.5%, an increase of 20.1 points, with gains most pronounced from 10 to 100 and again from 100 to 500, and diminishing though still positive returns from 500 to 2000.
falsification: A re-measurement of the same system showing a monotone, non-saturating curve would falsify this reading of it.

statement: The one curve in this set whose environments are reshaped rather than generated keeps rising while the others flatten: EnvHarness reports a resolved rate on SWE-bench Verified improving from 47.67% to 54.79%, a 7.12-point gain, where 'both original and generated environments flattened out at higher environment counts'.
falsification: A reading of the same experiment in which the original and generated baselines do not flatten would falsify this.

statement: Selection beats count in the measurement that isolates it: 30 ability-selected environments outperformed the full pool of 170, with an average relative gain of 95.6% over the base model against 43.4% for the full pool and 44.6% for a random 30.
falsification: A comparable run in which the full pool beats the selected subset would falsify this.

statement: Corpus quality is measurable and poor in bulk: RIVER reports that over 60% of environments exhibited at least one quality issue, leaving fewer than 40% suitable, and that using fewer than 30% of the training environments improved RL gains by 106% and 30% on two terminal benchmarks.
falsification: A quality audit of the same collection finding fewer than 60% defective, or a run in which the full set beats the filtered one, would falsify this.

statement: Repairing an environment is a quality intervention with no new environment added: Echoverse reports that repairing a single environment lifts the model trained on it from 16.2% to 38.5%, and that on the same domains shallow environments push accuracy from 80.0 to 75.0 while deep ones raise it from 80.0 to 85.0.
falsification: A re-run in which the repaired environment does not move its model, or in which a shallow environment raises accuracy, would falsify this.

statement: The counter-argument at the level of what is constructed: ReAgent claims that scaling programmatic environments via executable paths induces a 'construction-induced selection bias toward feasible requests', so requests that are blocked, conditionally feasible or feasible only after a compliant revision are under-represented; it retained 2415 of 3039 environment candidates and built 2360 feasible and 2252 conflict multi-turn scenarios.
falsification: A measurement of such a corpus showing no under-representation of blocked or conditionally feasible requests would falsify the claim.

statement: This repository's own gate family is an instance of the interaction class C08 names: all twelve runs changed src/formatter.py to satisfy a test that contradicts the package's documented rule, scoring 0/3 on every arm.
falsification: A re-run of the g02 gate task in which some arm stops and names the conflict instead of amending the specification would weaken this instance.

statement: The cheapest environment-side lever in the set is the verifier rather than the environment count: R2E-Gym reports that each verifier class alone saturates around 42-43% while the hybrid reaches 51% on SWE-bench Verified.
falsification: A run in which the hybrid verifier does not exceed either class alone would falsify this.

statement: The environment-side designer loop is closed by fresh rollouts, not by a weight update: EnvRigger's Validate stage runs fresh rollouts of the policy in the reshaped environment and accepts a component only if it cultivates the missing capability and remains solvable, rejects it if unsolvable or not challenging, and otherwise refines it.
falsification: A reading of EnvRigger in which a component is accepted without a rollout in the reshaped environment would falsify this.

statement: The repository's own corpus-wide corpus-verdict metric is a false_completion/claims ratio of 0.224 across 1454 ledgers, read from the counters fold, and it is the only ratio in the ledger that measures the layer's effect rather than its traffic.
falsification: A re-run of tezgah-status --counters --all on this machine returning a materially different ratio over the same ledger corpus would falsify this.

statement: The repository's own failure-shape fold reads 1661 ledgers and finds 8 shapes recurring in at least 5 distinct sessions, the widest reach being drift at 177 sessions and 225 fires, task at 80 and 168, and consent at 46 and 95.
falsification: A re-run of bin/tezgah-status --failure-shapes on this machine returning other counts over the same corpus would falsify this.

statement: The lab's own numbers do not span its whole corpus: the corpus holds 48 task directories, the pilot block covers 25 tasks at k=3 reading 0.95, 0.94, 0.96 and 0.93 with CPS of 0.0058, 0.0047, 0.0057 and 0.0074, and the hard family pools to 40/50; no block runs all 48 tasks.
falsification: A block in benchmarks/arm-bench covering all 48 tasks would falsify the last clause.

statement: The adaptation splits in two and only one half can move a pass rate: environment-side work on benchmarks/arm-bench can act on the 3 non-saturated pilot tasks plus the 5 hard tasks plus the 3 gate tasks, where the harness delta is 0.012 and 0.036 and the hard family pools to 40/50, while gate- or allowlist-side work can move the refusal counts and the 0.224 ratio at no spend; nothing here can move a weight, and no source's headline number is reachable without a training loop.
falsification: An environment-side change that moves a pass rate with no corpus work, or a session-side change that moves the pass rate, would falsify the split.

statement: The environment-side adaptation is built and pre-registered but unrun: benchmarks/arm-bench's corpus gains tasks/h06-exact-split-sum, a hidden-invariant task whose hidden check evaluates the documented split contract over 2828 cells and fails five plausible wrong implementations on 1239 to 1784 of them while two correct ones pass every cell, with the free selftest reading 48/48, and the one pre-registered cell - opencode-bare, k=12, about $0.08 - blocked because the provider account has no credit left.
falsification: A row from that cell or from any arm on the task that contradicts the pre-registered rate, a selftest run showing the fixture does not discriminate, or a sweep in which one of the five plausible wrong implementations passes every cell, would falsify this row.

statement: The corpus change did not raise the discriminating share on the arm it was spent on: the pre-registered cell read opencode-bare 12 of 12 passes on h06-exact-split-sum with the hidden invariant green in every row and 0 rows in the green-suite-wrong-contract shape, Wilson 75.7 to 100.0 at k=12, CPS $0.006389 and $0.082890 spent including the probe row, so both of the protocol's predictions were falsified and the count of corpus tasks that can discriminate is where C15 left it.
falsification: A re-run of the same cell, or the armed member of the pair on the same task, landing at or below 3 of 12 passes, or any row whose visible suite passed while the hidden invariant failed, would falsify this row.
